remarks:
This beautifully updated brick home is truly move-in ready and waiting for someone to call it home! From the moment you arrive, you’ll notice the attention to detail, including all-new exterior LED lighting, new doors, fresh landscaping, a three-car-wide driveway A charming covered front porch provides the perfect spot to sit back and relax.

Step into the fully fenced backyard, complete with a great barbecue and entertaining area, before heading inside where the real WOW factor begins! The light and bright remodeled interior features beautiful new luxury vinyl flooring and LED lighting throughout the main level.

The open family room is warm and inviting with custom built-ins, bench seating, and a wood-burning fireplace. The stunning remodeled kitchen features high-end Quartz countertops, all-new white cabinetry, full plywood construction with soft close doors all new stainless steel appliances, a wine chiller, garbage disposal, and a deep 16-gauge stainless steel sink. Just off the kitchen, the spacious living and dining room combination creates the open, airy layout everyone is looking for. A beautifully remodeled full bath with shower completes the main level.

Upstairs, you’ll find all-new carpeting with thick upgraded padding, three generously sized bedrooms with built-ins and ample closet space, plus another tastefully updated bathroom featuring a double floating vanity.

The dry basement offers plenty of additional storage along with a small workshop area. Additional updates include brand-new central A/C and hot water tank, plus a newer furnace and electrical.

This brick beauty has been thoughtfully remodeled from top to bottom and is truly turnkey with nothing left to do but move in and enjoy!

Come take a peek at the Open House Saturday, October 10th from 1:00–3:00 PM!
